tasks.goal: Add deterministic QC pipeline to extract_features.py: compute per-geometry validity checks (face count, volume, surface area sanity), flag outliers by IQR on each metric, write QC report CSV. Preserve existing feature columns and add qc_valid (bool), qc_outlier_flags (list[str]), qc_zscore dict.

Implement geometric representation module: compute signed/unsigned distance field samples on a regular grid over the mitral annulus ROI, plus Laplace-Beltrami spectrum features (first 10 eigenvalues) from STL mesh. Output as numpy arrays with consistent shape.

Write a rigorous technical roadmap in PLAN.md: map each project objective to concrete tasks with file paths, estimate complexity, identify dependencies, and define success criteria for each milestone. Update PROGRESS.md with current milestone completion status.
